integrity: The infinite claim is supported by a case-by-case algebraic proof. The attached executable checks finite rings only. Prior algebraic and dynamical identities are credited.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to odd prime powers and the generalized Fibonacci recurrence with second parameter minus one.
It does not determine periods of the recurrence state map or exact first-zero ranks for characteristic two.
An unindexed stronger formula for roots of second-kind Chebyshev polynomials may imply part or all of the result; no independent novelty examination has been performed.
title: Exact prime-power rank distributions for generalized Fibonacci sequences
